sources.recommend_reason_zh: Amazon博客介绍HOPE二阶专家剪枝：Qwen3.5-122B的48层每层256个experts、约250GB内存95%被expert MLPs占用，而每token仅用8个；50%剪枝下在agentic coding任务最多比次优方法高6.1%。

en.reason: Second-order HOPE expert pruning targets Qwen3.5-122B's 48 MoE layers of 256 experts, where expert MLPs occupy 95% of ~250 GB memory though each token uses only 8, beating the next-best by up to 6.1% at 50% pruning on agentic coding.
